label: Fix 4 bugs in blob-store: getStream resource leak, gcProgress deadlock, put() missing O_EXCL, FdGuard existence check
summary: Fixed 4 bugs across store.ts and fd-guard.ts in @adhd/sox-blob-store. All changes pass build, test (36/36), and lint.

changes.kind: Bug 1 (high) — getStream resource leak: wrapped fdGuard.acquire() + file handle setup in try/catch so release() is always called on setup failure
Bug 2 (high) — gcProgress() deadlock: added guard check before await to prevent hang when GC is not running; added emitGcProgress() in gc() finally block to wake up listeners on GC end
Bug 3 (medium) — put() missing O_EXCL: replaced fsp.writeFile() with fsp.open('wx') + fd.writeFile() + fd.close()
Bug 4 (medium) — pass this.has as existsChecker to InProcessFdGuard constructor
Bug 4 (medium) — FdGuard.acquire() existence check: added optional existsChecker parameter; acquire() throws BlobNotFound if blob doesn't exist on disk

handoff_notes: InProcessFdGuard now imports BlobNotFound from ./errors.js — any downstream consumers constructing InProcessFdGuard directly must account for the new optional constructor parameter

The InProcessFdGuard is instantiated in BlobStore field initializer with `async (hash: string) => this.has(hash)` as the existsChecker — this is safe because acquire() is only called after store.open()
